_about: Masala Kitchen's four rotating weekly lunch menus, typed in by hand from the menu images on masalakitchen.se/lunch (version 'nov2025' / 'dec2025'). The reader picks this week's number from the 'Veckans Meny' tab. diet: vegan = marked V on the menu, veg = vegetarian but not marked vegan. If the restaurant changes its menus, these need typing in again.
